Rhinoplasty reshapes the bone and cartilage of the nose – to change its size or shape, to correct an asymmetry or, where needed, to improve breathing. The plan is made together with your surgeon. MedLuxLife arranges your online consultation with the surgeon in Istanbul and organises your stay.

Quick facts

Anaesthesia

General anaesthesia

Operation time

About 2–4 hours

Hospital stay

Usually 1 night

Nasal splint

Removed after 5–7 days

Stay in Türkiye

Planned individually with the clinic

General information; your surgeon plans the details for you personally.

Who it may be suitable for

  • You would like to change the shape or size of your nose.
  • You have breathing problems, for example because of a deviated septum.
  • The growth of your face is complete.
  • You are in good general health and do not smoke, or are ready to stop for the surgery.

Whether the procedure is suitable for you is decided by the surgeon after a personal assessment.

Types of rhinoplasty

Cosmetic rhinoplasty

Changes the size, tip or nostrils, or corrects an asymmetry.

Functional rhinoplasty

Septorhinoplasty improves breathing, for example with a deviated septum.

How the operation is performed

Consultation with the surgeon

Before the operation, the surgeon examines you in person, discusses your wishes and confirms the final plan.

Anaesthesia and preparation

On the day of surgery you receive general anaesthesia and sleep throughout the operation. The team marks and prepares the area to be treated.

The procedure

Through small incisions inside the nostrils or at the base of the nose, the surgeon reshapes bone and cartilage according to the plan.

Closure and first care

A protective splint is placed on the nose. You are monitored closely and usually stay in hospital for one night.

How it works with MedLuxLife

1Contact and online consultation

Contact us and tell us what you are interested in. We refer you to the right surgeon for an online consultation. Photos or medical documents go directly to the doctor, only on request.

2Your personal plan

The surgeon recommends the right approach for you. We plan your dates, flights, hotel and transfers around it.

3Arrival and surgery

After a pre-operative examination, the operation takes place as planned. You usually stay in hospital for one night.

4Recovery in Istanbul

You rest in your hotel and attend the check-ups at the clinic. The surgeon decides when you are ready to fly home.

5Back home

Stay in touch with us on WhatsApp – we help with follow-up questions.

Recovery step by step

First week

Bruising and swelling around the eyes usually go down within 7–10 days. The splint is removed after 5–7 days.

First month

Most of the swelling goes down. Avoid strenuous activity and follow the care instructions of your surgeon.

Months 6–12

The tissues settle slowly; the final shape of the nose usually shows after 6–12 months.

Frequently asked questions

Usually 2–4 hours under general anaesthesia, followed by about one night in hospital.

Modern techniques such as ultrasonic (piezo) surgery are used. Discomfort after the operation is usually mild and is treated with medication; swelling and bruising around the eyes usually go down within 7–10 days.

The surgeon removes the splint and any nasal packing after about 5–7 days.

Most swelling goes down within the first month; the final, detailed shape usually shows after 6–12 months.

This is planned individually with the clinic. We organise your flights and hotel accordingly.

No. If the surgeon needs photos or documents, you share them directly with the doctor in your online consultation.

Plan your rhinoplasty

Contact us and tell us what you are interested in – we refer you to the right specialist for an online consultation.

Request a Free Consultation
WhatsApp

The information on this page is for general guidance only and does not replace a medical consultation. Suitability for any treatment is assessed individually by a qualified doctor.
